title: "Act Like a 5th Grader" is Not Enough: Bounding Knowledge in LLM-Based User Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2608.30033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior but frequently fail to exhibit realistic cognitive constraints, suffering from a "superhuman bias." Using a dataset of over 71,000 reading comprehension responses from 2,359 primary-school students (grades 4--6), we demonstrate that standard persona prompting yields near-perfect, deterministic performance, failing to capture the natural variance of developing readers. To address this, we introduce the Cognitively Bounded User Simulator (CBUS), an architectural framework that explicitly models the restricted working memory of young readers through an episodic bottleneck. Within this framework, we formalize two distinct test-taking strategies to emulate different reading behaviors. translated_title: “表现得像五年级学生”还不够：为基于大语言模型的用户模拟器设定知识边界
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于模拟人类行为，但它们常常无法展现出真实的认知约束，存在“超人偏差”问题。利用一个包含来自2,359名小学生（4至6年级）超过71,000条阅读理解回答的数据集，我们证明标准的人设提示方法会产生近乎完美、确定性的表现，无法捕捉处于发展阶段的阅读者的自然差异。为解决这一问题，我们提出了认知受限用户模拟器（CBUS），这是一个架构框架，通过情景瓶颈显式建模年轻读者受限的工作记忆。在该框架内，我们形式化了两种不同的应试策略，以模拟不同的阅读行为。我们的评估表明，显式建模认知约束在多个LLM骨干模型上显著缩小了模拟差距，证明了强制执行架构约束……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出认知受限用户模拟器（CBUS）框架，通过情景瓶颈显式建模小学生受限的工作记忆和不同的应试策略，有效解决了LLM用户模拟器的“超人偏差”问题，并显著缩小了模拟差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CBUS, a cognitively bounded user simulator framework that explicitly models young readers' restricted working memory through an episodic bottleneck and formalizes distinct test-taking strategies, addressing the "superhuman bias" in LLM-based user simulators and significantly narrowing the simulation gap.
